chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Fletcher Henderson college dates and next-session note (second version)
summary: Mosley played Harvard, Yale and Dartmouth with Fletcher between Claude Hopkins and Fats; Driggs plans a follow-up session.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Fletcher would have
wanted a couple of you guys.
I could have gone with Fletcher, in fact, I later went with Fletcher. You know that.
I didn't know that.

Yeah, I played Harvard, Yale, Dartmouth. I'll never forget, I had that llama coat that you saw in that bus and we got into New Hampshire, or somewhere like that, the bus couldn't move there was so much snow--
You were with Fletcher?
I was with Fletcher; yes.
Is this right after (inaudible) band broke up?
No.
Or during that time when he was laying off?
No, this was way later. This was in between Claude Hopkins and Fats.
Oh yeah, yeah; right around the time Fletcher was reorganizing.
Yeah.
After that band broke up with Paul Jones and Kate Johnson and all of them, Benny Carter--not Benny Carter--
I don't remember who was there.
Ben Webster and Joe Thomas on trumpet; Red Allen. Red Allen wasn't in the band?
I don't think so. I don't remember who he was in the band with.
This must have been the time that he was reorganizing, around '35.
Yes. It was between the time that I was with--
Probably between the time that you left Claude and went with Fats.
Right; it was.
That's possible. Next time we get together I'll get
all those little--I'll transcribe these reels of tape and then I'll be filling in all the different things when we get together again.
Oh yeah, sure.
Afterwards, we have to make five hours. We got to earn our salary here.
I don't mind at all. After we get through with this, I'd like to make another one.
